prompt_overrides.implement.execute: Implement the frozen Spec and Plan, run the fixed checker and wait for its confirmed completion. If it reports an ordinary content-validation failure, correct only the specified artifact and rerun the unchanged checker to verify that correction. If a shell tool yields a session_id or running status, poll that same pending command; do not launch another checker while the original is pending or its result is unknown. The checker may contain a bounded driver-owned gate; preserve it and the original pending command. Commit only the specified artifact after the checker succeeds. Report actual changes and verification. Publication is a separate Runner stage.
prompt_overrides.publish: Publish the already verified committed artifact by running powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./sr-smoke/publish.ps1 once in the assigned sandbox. Wait for this original command to finish and report its actual PR URL. If the shell tool yields a session_id or running status, poll that same session until its final exit status and complete output; polling observes the original command and is required, not a second publication. Preserve an uncertain publication for original branch/PR reconciliation; never create a replacement. The test driver owns merge and test gates.
